title: Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders: Error-Return Refund Amount
content:
**Payments & Refunds desk statement.**

For Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, the error-return refund is the units received back multiplied by the unit refund value, plus the error allowance, the refund-wait credit, the drop-off credit, the repeat-issue credit and the Autoship-tenure credit, added together and rounded half up to the cent once at the end. The unit price paid is the amount billed on the order's line charges divided by the units charged on them, rounded half up to the cent. The unit refund value is the unit price paid, and the error allowance, the refund-wait credit, the drop-off credit, the repeat-issue credit and the Autoship-tenure credit are each nothing.

## Inputs and their records

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Authorization settled | The latest return authorization on the order in status received, by received date |
| Units received back | The units on that authorization |
| Reason | The reason on that authorization; the refund applies when it is damaged, defective, wrong item or not as described (the method's fee-waived reasons), and is nothing otherwise |
| Amount billed on the line charges | The total amount billed on the order's line charges |
| Units charged | The total units on the order's line charges |
| Unit price paid | Amount billed divided by units charged, rounded half up to the cent |

## Rounding points

The unit price paid is rounded to the cent when it is formed. The refund itself is rounded once, after the units-times-value amount and the credits have been added together.

## Worked example (hypothetical order)

A hypothetical order has one line charge of 3 units billed $53.97. Its unit price paid is $53.97 divided by 3, that is $17.99. The latest received authorization carries 2 units with reason defective. The refund is 2 times $17.99, that is $35.98, plus nothing for each credit: $35.98.

A second hypothetical order has line charges of 3 units billed $50.00 in total. The unit price paid is $16.666..., rounded to $16.67; 3 units received back give $50.01.

If the latest received authorization carried reason changed mind, this refund would be nothing; that return is refunded under the general return rules.
